changes.title: Call and book from any phone.
changes.text: The current homepage shrinks to fit a phone screen. The concept puts a tap to call button and a service request at the top of every screen.

changes.title: Your reviews up front.
changes.text: Customers praise your technicians by name on your testimonials page. The concept brings three of those quotes onto the homepage.

changes.title: A secure, current site.
changes.text: Browsers mark the current site Not Secure and its banner no longer loads. The concept is built to load fast and work in every browser.
